ports.write: four independently enabled byte-masked128bit writes at native stripe rows; no arbitration
ports.read: one common native row; doutb_o[p*128+:128] belongs to stripe p
ports.commit: 33bit exclusive prefix = minimum of all stripe prefixes
ports.errors: combinational enabled out-of-range indicators, disabled while aresetn=0

reset_visibility: Synchronous reset clears prefixes and first-fresh-read visibility. Internal primitive memory retained. Output remains0 after reset until a post-reset read matures at the original configured latency.
clear: Suppresses writes and clears prefix metadata on the edge; does not reset read pipeline or erase memory. Epoch draining and ownership stay external.
common_start_done_waiver: The explicitly frozen native bank-leaf contract takes priority over generic kernel start_i/done_o defaults. This memory accepts native requests at II1.
numeric_scope: Opaque packed storage only. Scales, W4/A4/KV4 quantization method, real checkpoint packing and arithmetic are not frozen or validated here.
does_not_claim: full Smol model correctness or quality
